eyebrow: Bilong ol fama bilong kopi long olgeta hap
title: Luksave long ol senis long lip bilong kopi.
introduction: Wanpela poto, sampela bekim, na wanpela ripot bilong soim long ofisa bilong agrikalsa long ples bilong yu. Crop Health Assistant i helpim yu long luksave pastaim. Em i no inap tokaut stret long sik.
validationLabel: Mipela i stat wantaim ol manmeri long PNG
availabilityTitle: Yu no inap sekim poto yet
availabilityText: Mipela i wokim yet rot bilong sekim lip. Bai mipela i putim poto, ol bekim bilong AI na daunlod bilong ripot bihain.

journey.title: Putim poto bilong lip
journey.description: Kisim klia poto bilong wanpela lip bilong kopi long lait bilong san.

journey.title: Tokim mipela long samting yu lukim
journey.description: Bekim sampela sotpela askim. Yu inap makim Mi no save.

journey.title: Ritim ol samting mipela i lukim
journey.description: Lukim ol mak long lip, samting mipela i no save stret, na tok bilong helpim long ples bilong yu, sapos i gat.

journey.title: Redim wanpela ripot
journey.description: Daunlod ripot na yu yet soim long ofisa bilong agrikalsa long ples bilong yu.

beforeTitle: Ol samting yu mas save long en
uncertaintyTitle: Sekim poto i gat mak bilong en
uncertaintyText: Poto tasol i no inap tokaut stret long sik o tok olsem diwai i no gat sik.
regionalTitle: Tok bilong helpim i mas stret long ples
regionalText: Tok ol i bin sekim bilong PNG i no stret long olgeta ples. Sapos mipela i no gat tok bilong ples bilong yu, mipela bai tokaut na askim yu long kisim helpim long ofisa bilong agrikalsa long ples.
sessionText: Yu bai nidim intenet long sekim poto. Sapos yu opim pes gen o pasim tab, ol samting bilong sek bai lus. Tokples yu makim tasol bai stap long divais bilong yu.
translationNotice: Dispela Tok Pisin i draf tasol. Wanpela man o meri i save gut long Tok Pisin i no sekim yet.
footer: Kopi tasol em i krop bilong dispela namba wan app. Mipela bai stat traim wantaim ol manmeri long PNG. Mipela i no pinisim yet.
screeningStatement: Sekim pastaim tasol, em i no tokaut stret long sik.

assessment.prototype: Ol samting i luk olsem long lip
assessment.intro: Ol fama bilong kopi long olgeta hap i ken yusim. Mipela i plenim wok bilong traim wantaim ol fama long PNG pastaim. Riviu bilong agrikalsa na tokples i no pinis yet.
assessment.photoTitle: Stat wantaim klia poto bilong lip bilong kopi.
assessment.photoHelp: Yusim lait bilong san na soim olgeta hap bilong lip i gat senis. Sapos inap, putim poto bilong aninit bilong lip tu. No putim pes, pepa o samting i soim husat yu.
assessment.limits: Wanpela o tupela JPEG, PNG o WebP poto. Original poto i mas no winim 10 MiB na 40 megapiksel. Kopi i go long seva i no winim 1600 piksel na 2 MiB. Senisim HEIC i go long JPEG pastaim.
assessment.privacy: Taim yu makim Sekim ol poto o Kisim risalt, ol poto na bekim i go long seva bilong dispela app na Google. App i no save holim ol keis. Ol lo bilong Google bilong yusim na holim data i stap yet. Dispela divais i tingim tokples yu makim tasol.
assessment.temporary: Sapos yu refresh o pasim dispela tab, ol poto, bekim na risalt bai lus. Ripoti yu daunlod i stap long divais inap yu dilitim. Sekim i nidim intanet.
assessment.demoPrivacy: Dispela sevis i yusim fri Gemini tier. Salim sample data tasol we yu gat tok orait long serim aninit long ol lo bilong Google. No putim praivet data bilong fama.
assessment.paidPrivacy: Ol poto na bekim i go long paid Gemini sevis bilong Google.
assessment.permission: Mi gat tok orait long salim ol dispela poto na bekim.
